description: Fetch human-reviewed drug-specific clinical-risk signals for a project, including biomarker quality, Phase 1 ORR flag-only data, provenance, extractor versions, and pending-review counts. Use this before interpreting model 2.6.0 drug-specific multipliers or flags.

project_id.description: UUID of the project whose reviewed drug-specific clinical-risk signals should be queried.

name: query_drug_risk

outputSchema.description: Canonical PhaseFolio envelope. Substantive payload is in `data`.

data.description: Drug-specific clinical-risk substrate for a project. Returns reviewed signals only; pending rows are counted but excluded from scoring.

drug_name.description: Project asset name used to match reviewed drug-specific signal rows.

extractor_versions.description: Recent extractor prompt versions that produced this signal family.

pending_count.description: Number of matching signal rows still waiting for human review.

phase1_orr_treatment.description: Phase 1 ORR is surfaced but not scored in model 2.6.0.

project_id.description: Project UUID used to anchor the lookup.

reviewed_count.description: Number of reviewed approved/amended signals returned.

scoring_gate.description: Human-review gate required before a signal can score.

scoring_review_decisions.description: Review decisions eligible for scoring or surfacing.

signals.description: Reviewed signal rows with provenance, extracted values, review state, and OR metadata.
